description: This file defines a Java class 'MergeSortedAsPair' which implements an Akka Streams GraphStage for merging two sorted streams into pairs of elements, delivering tuples before the final comparison. It provides static methods to create instances based on a comparator or comparable type, and contains internal logic to handle stream completion and element merging while respecting sorting order.
